clues: This city in northern Italy sits in the flat wide plain of the Po River.
Winters here are cold and foggy, and rain falls most in spring and autumn. Summers bring humid heat and thunderstorms.
This is one of the oldest city sites in north Italy. Most historians say it began near 600 BC.
Growing rice is the big work around this city. It is a main centre for the rice crop.
In summer, water fills the rice fields here. They ring the city on every side.
